outcome: compliance with clinical guidelines for gestational age at delivery
rates of unplanned labour before scheduled CS
cohort: 557 elective caesarean section cases (283 pre-implementation, 274 post-implementation) at a tertiary obstetric centre in Australia.
finding: The introduction of an electronic CS booking form improved compliance with clinical guidelines for recommended gestational age at delivery, particularly for patients with maternal or neonatal risk factors.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery, particularly focusing on compliance with guidelines for delivery before 39 weeks.
